## Activity

River Outreach recorded 23 captures during January 2022. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists managed in the usual way apart from routine leave. Of the 23 captures, 2 were ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 8.7 per cent. The result identifies a small proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. The ungradable captures should be considered when reviewing the overall quality of activity for January 2022.

## Grading
